blockers.reason: No single fixture executes and records all mandatory assertions/negative cases over O/M/R/C/S/T/E.
Registered projection profile/mapping and its non-interference operation are not implemented.
Freeze executable public API procedures and declared contracts for every N01–N11 case before running the gate.

input_contract.input_policy: Explicit deterministic source records, acquisition coordinates and horizon; no wall clock, UUID or creation counter in semantic inputs.
input_contract.contracts_policy: Register and resolve exact source/schema/operator/relation/composition/state/transition/conformance criterion/contract versions through production Registry; fixture cannot supply missing calculus rules.
input_contract.run_policy: Two independent Pipelines with equivalent declared inputs/context/contracts; additionally permute admissible insertion order.
input_contract.identity_policy: Use actual production identity APIs. Compare canonical bytes and semantic references; do not replace hash or assume u64 collision freedom.

forbidden_terms_scope: semantic artifact types/labels only; ordinary diagnostics and external representations are not semantic namespace violations
acceptance_predicate: Every mandatory assertion and negative case actually executed and has harness_status PASS.
Every actual result matches its declared expectation; expected FAIL/UNRESOLVED can yield harness PASS.
Canon(run_1 graph O/M/R/C/S/T/E) equals Canon(run_2 graph).
Every affected upstream semantic snapshot equals its before-operation snapshot.
No forbidden semantic artifact is introduced.
Projection non-interference is executed under an explicit registered profile.
No mandatory case is skipped, silently assumed, NOT_EXECUTED or BLOCKED.

execution_report_contract.no_evaluation_policy: semantic_result=null when evaluation did not execute or no contract resolved; NOT_EXECUTED is never a semantic result

scope_limits: Component tests and old two smoke E2E tests do not certify this gate.
006 failed-construction invalid object retention does not imply retrospective invalidation of already admitted objects or descendant propagation.
Horizon filters declared source timestamps, not ingestion/available_at/decision_at or general historical as-of knowledge.
Context/source/version references are declared contracts, not external authentication or causal truth.
